claim_boundary: Development-only layer-59 screen of a frozen prompt-group robust support estimator. Even a pass can only authorize a second new-prompt replication; it cannot establish whole-model quality, benchmark retention, CPU speed, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a breakthrough.

data_status.allowed_use: Reject or admit the fixed estimator to a second newly authored prompt replication only.
